summary: Extended Elite to Personalities in BattleForce (same rule as Followers: bowed Elite still counts). Replaced CardInstance.AddedKeywords with a duration-aware CardInstance.GrantedKeywords (Attachment/Turn/Permanent), with expiry wired into FinishTurn and DestroyAttachment. Generalized the Chi<=0 destruction check into ApplyModifier so any future Chi-reducing effect enforces it, not just the one prior call site. CardView exposes GrantedKeywords for the paired UI issue.
